source.quote: Schiit specification sheets and Stereophile's sidebar, read 2026-11-20: Unison USB, AES/EBU XLR, RCA and BNC S/PDIF and optical, ALL limited to 24-bit/192 kHz. Unusual in this catalogue in that USB holds no advantage - the whole design stops at 192 kHz, which is consistent with a multibit ladder that is not asked to go higher.
